name: draw_fixed_region_rectangle

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1079E
name: draw_optional_text_items
description: Sets a drawing mode, then draws two fixed text items at constant offsets from the base data, and a third item only when the argument is nonzero. Each item is drawn through one routine using a constant string pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10806
name: draw_done_cancel_labels
description: Sets the pen color, moves to a fixed position and draws a four-character Done label when the argument is nonzero, then moves to a second fixed position and always draws the six-character Cancel label.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:108A2
name: draw_bounds_outline_polyline
description: Builds a five-point closed outline from a four-value bounds record, moves to the first corner through a library call, and passes the point list to a polyline routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1091A
name: open_window_or_report_error
description: Opens a display window from a parameter block through a library call, stores the returned handle in the state record, and returns whether the window opened. When the handle is null it reports the message that a window could not be opened.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10948
name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the constant one and performs no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10966
name: close_window_and_clear_handle
description: If a window handle is stored in the state record, closes it through a library call, releases a second resource with fixed values, clears the stored handle, and then calls one subroutine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1099C
name: read_entry_block_or_fallback
description: Builds a name in a 32-byte buffer and opens the entry chosen by a numeric selector. When the entry opens it reads a 512-byte block into the destination and closes it, otherwise it calls a library routine on the destination with a fixed flag, and it returns whether the entry opened.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:109D6
name: call_library_and_return_one
description: Calls a library routine with no arguments, calls one subroutine, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:109F4
name: read_alternate_entry_block
description: Builds a name in a 32-byte buffer, runs a setup subroutine when a state word is zero, and opens the entry chosen by a second numeric selector. When it opens, it reads a 512-byte block into the destination, closes the entry, and returns whether it opened.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10A26
name: perform_two_setup_steps
description: Calls two subroutines in sequence and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10A44
name: build_chess_saves_path_prefix
description: Clears the first byte of a name buffer and appends the ChessSaves text, running a setup subroutine first when a state word is zero. It then appends the colon-terminated ChessSaves text, so the buffer holds a volume-style name prefix.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10A90
name: initialize_record_then_dispatch
description: Zeros the leading words of a record, sets a constant byte, a base-relative pointer and a third parameter into it, and then passes the record and the first parameter to another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10AE4
name: init_serial_receive_interrupts
description: Installs an interrupt handler through a library call, points the receive buffer state at its storage, clears and then sets the serial receive interrupt enable bit in the interrupt enable register, and writes the serial period register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10B26
name: send_bytes_over_serial
description: Writes a byte string to the serial data register one byte at a time with the stop bit set, waiting on the transmit-buffer-empty bit of the serial status register before each byte. It stops when the count given in the second argument reaches zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10B4A
name: send_serial_bytes_counted
description: Sends a counted run of bytes through the serial data register with the stop bit set, writing the current byte before waiting on the transmit-buffer-empty bit of the serial status register between bytes. The remaining length counts down as it goes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10B5E
name: stub_return_only
description: Stub that only returns; the decompiled body contains no instructions beyond the return, so no behaviour is recovered from it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10B66
name: read_serial_ring_buffer_bytes
description: Copies the requested number of bytes from the receive ring buffer into the caller's buffer, waiting for each byte with a short timeout polled through a library tick call. Returns zero when the count is met and minus one when the wait times out.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10BB0
name: read_ring_buffer_bytes_timed
description: Copies bytes from the receive ring buffer using a time limit kept in the stack frame, returning minus one once that limit passes before the count is met and zero when all bytes are copied. The read position wraps at the end of the buffer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10BDE
name: return_negative_one
description: Returns minus one and performs no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10BE8
name: read_ring_buffer_bytes_polled
description: Reads a counted run of bytes from the receive ring buffer, polling a library tick value while the buffer is empty, returning minus one when the wait window expires and zero when the count is reached.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10BEA
name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns zero and performs no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10BEE
name: clear_receive_ring_buffer
description: Sets the receive ring buffer read position equal to its write position, discarding all bytes that were received but not yet read.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10BFC
name: count_pending_receive_bytes
description: Returns the number of bytes waiting in the receive ring buffer, computed as the write position minus the read position, with the buffer size of 128 included when the write position is behind the read position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10C1E
name: compute_wrapped_ring_distance
description: Computes a wrapped distance between a position held in the caller's frame and the receive ring buffer read pointer, adding a 128-byte wrap, stores the result in a stack slot and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10C36
name: disable_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Clears the serial receive interrupt enable bit by writing the interrupt enable register, then calls a library routine with a fixed interrupt number and the saved handle.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10C54
name: store_received_byte_in_ring
description: Stores a received byte taken from the state record at the write position of the receive ring buffer, wrapping after its 128-byte region, advances the write position, and sets a status word to a fixed constant.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10C7E
name: send_checksummed_serial_packet
description: Computes a two-lane checksum over a text packet by adding its bytes into alternating lanes, writes the packet and checksum through a library output routine, and then reads reply bytes from the serial receive buffer. Reply bytes are compared against the backslash and open-bracket codes, and a read timeout sends a fixed four-byte marker and clears the first packet byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10CAC
name: receive_checksummed_serial_packet
description: Adds the bytes of a received text packet into two alternating checksum lanes, writes the checksum through a library output routine and reads reply bytes from the serial receive buffer. A read timeout sends a fixed four-byte marker, and an unexpected reply code reports an error through a library routine and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10D08
name: retry_send_with_attempt_limit
description: A first marker byte value triggers two library send calls before a retry loop; any byte that is neither marker reports a fixed message and returns. The loop runs up to five check attempts, sending a four-byte command and clearing the marker byte after each failed attempt, and reports a second fixed message when every attempt fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10D2C
name: retry_send_after_collision
description: Retries a check up to five times, sending a four-byte command and clearing the marker byte after each failure, and sends two commands when the alternate marker is seen. The code references the text 'Sending at the same time...try again' and reports a fixed message through a library call when a byte is neither marker value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10D4C
name: retry_until_opponent_replies
description: Runs up to five check attempts, sending a four-byte command and clearing the marker byte after each failed attempt, and sends two commands when the alternate marker is seen. The referenced text is 'Opponent not responding', and a byte that is neither marker value reports a fixed message and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10DBA
name: parse_received_record_stream
description: Parses one received buffer: low-valued bytes are treated as text lines ended by a carriage return and checked against the four-byte string ATE, while records with the high-nibble marker are length-prefixed frames whose two trailing bytes are compared against a computed sum. The record codes for the two reply commands send one of two four-byte reply strings through a library call or set a status flag, and the routine returns minus one once the send check fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10E42
name: scan_records_for_pending_reply
description: Walks received records, summing each record's bytes into a two-character field and comparing it with the stored pair. On a match it sends one of two four-byte reply strings for the reply code or sets a status flag for the other code, and it returns zero for any unrecognised code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10E72
name: poll_reply_until_match
description: Sets a status byte, then polls an input check and walks records, computing the same two-character sum, until the sum matches the stored pair. A matching reply code sends one of two four-byte strings chosen by the status byte, and the loop repeats while the code is the second reply code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10E7A
name: send_status_then_poll_reply
description: Sends one of two four-byte status strings chosen by a status byte, then polls the input check and walks records until the computed sum matches. It returns minus one when no input is pending and zero for an unrecognised reply code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10E88
name: resend_status_command_until_matched
description: Sends the first four-byte status string, polls the input check, and walks records until a computed sum matches. When the status byte is set it switches to the alternate status string and retries, and it returns zero for unrecognised codes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10EA2
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero immediately without performing any other operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10EAC
name: dispatch_pending_reply_command
description: Dispatches on a command code passed in: the first reply code sends one of two four-byte strings chosen by a status byte, the second reply code sets a status flag, and any other code returns zero. It then polls the input check and walks records until a computed sum matches, returning minus one when no input remains.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10EBA
name: poll_reply_command_sequence
description: Sets a status flag, then polls the input check and walks records until a computed sum matches the stored pair. A first reply code sends a four-byte reply string, a second reply code sets the status flag again, and unknown codes return zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10EC6
name: match_record_send_reply
description: Sets a status byte and walks received records, comparing each computed sum with the stored pair. On a match the reply code sends one of two four-byte strings or sets the status flag, and the loop repeats for the next record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10ED2
name: scan_text_and_framed_records
description: Scans received text lines and framed records, sending a four-byte reply string through a library call when a framed record's computed sum matches the stored pair. It returns minus one when no input remains and zero for an unknown record code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10EDA
name: scan_record_stream_for_reply
description: Processes a received buffer by first handling low-valued text lines through a carriage return scan, then checking framed records whose summed bytes are compared with a stored pair. A matching record sends the appropriate reply string or sets a status flag, and the routine returns minus one when the input check fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10F12
name: read_line_terminated_record
description: Clears the first byte of the output buffer and, for a text line, scans forward to a carriage return, forcing one where the scan fails. A non-empty line other than the four-byte string ATE triggers a fixed message through a library call, and the routine returns minus one when the input check fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10F4C
name: await_checksum_matched_reply
description: Reports a text state flag, then repeatedly polls for input and walks records until a computed sum matches the stored pair. A matching first reply code sends one of two four-byte strings, and a matching second reply code sets a status flag before polling again.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10F62
name: send_command_if_flagged
description: Checks two status words for the value two and, if either matches, writes a two-byte command with the bytes 161 and 37 onto the stack and passes a pointer to it to another routine. The status words are read from the base data of the program.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10FA6
name: send_command_from_argument_bytes
description: Builds a four-byte command with a fixed leading byte of 162 and a length byte of 6, copying two bytes from offsets one and three of the argument buffer. It then passes a pointer to the command buffer to another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:10FEA
name: send_constant_command
description: Places two constant command bytes, 169 and 5, on the stack and passes a pointer to them to another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1101E
name: send_command_and_clear_flag
description: Stores a four-byte constant on the stack, passes a pointer to it through a jump-table entry in the base data, and then clears a status byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11040
name: fill_buffer_countdown_bytes
description: Writes the low byte of a counter into each destination byte while counting down to zero, advancing the destination pointer after each write.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11054
name: advance_seed_return_high_word
description: Calls a library routine that returns a value, adds a fixed constant to it, and stores the sum in a state longword. It then returns the high word of that sum masked to 15 bits.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11088
name: store_upper_word_value
description: Writes the upper sixteen bits of its argument into a state longword.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1109A
name: convert_to_uppercase
description: Returns the low byte of its argument converted to uppercase when it is a lowercase ASCII letter, by subtracting 32. Other bytes are returned unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:110B2
name: convert_to_lowercase
description: Returns the low byte of its argument converted to lowercase when it is an uppercase ASCII letter, by adding 32. Other bytes are returned unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:110CA
name: clear_state_open_dos_library
description: Zeroes a large block of state longwords, stores the exec base and a supplied pointer into state fields, and calls exec Supervisor when a flag bit is set. It then opens dos.library through exec OldOpenLibrary, calling exec Alert on failure and another routine on success.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1113C
name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty stub that only returns, with no operations, and has a single recorded caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11144
name: allocate_tagged_cleared_block
description: Allocates a zero-filled memory block sized from a stored count times six, using the cleared-memory flag, and calls another routine with zero arguments and returns if the allocation fails. On success it writes the tag MANX into a node, then either links the result through library calls or sets the high-bit flags on the entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1127A
name: split_quoted_argument_string
description: Splits a command string into fields separated by spaces, tabs, carriage returns and newlines, unquoting double-quoted fields and keeping a doubled quote as one quote. It allocates a pointer array for the field starts, terminates it with a null pointer, and stores the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1127C
name: tokenize_argument_string_direct
description: Repeats the field-splitting logic of the neighbouring entry, splitting a command string on whitespace, unquoting quoted fields, and building a null-terminated pointer array through a library allocation call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1142C
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination buffer until a zero terminator or the count limit is reached, then fills any remaining count bytes with zeros. It returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1142E
name: copy_bounded_string_zero_fill
description: Performs the same bounded copy with zero padding as the neighbouring entry, copying from a source up to a count or a zero terminator and then zero-filling the rest of the count. It returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11450
name: copy_bytes_handling_overlap
description: Copies a counted number of bytes from source to destination, copying backwards from the end when the destination lies above the source so overlapping regions are preserved. It returns without action when the two pointers are equal.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1147A
name: append_string_fixed_limit
description: Advances to the terminator of the destination string and appends the source string under a fixed large length limit, writing a terminator at the end if the copy was cut short.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11480
name: copy_string_with_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of the destination, copying at most the count given in the third argument. It writes a terminator after the last byte when the limit stops the copy before the source ends.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:114A4
name: compare_two_byte_strings
description: Compares two byte strings up to a fixed length limit, returning minus one when the first differing byte is smaller in the first string, one when it is larger, and zero when the strings match through the terminator.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:114D4
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated source string into the destination, including the terminator, and returns the original destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:114E4
name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Combines the cross products of the 16-bit halves of two register operands into a 64-bit result whose high longword is that sum and whose low longword is the second operand. The routine makes no library calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11508
name: lookup_icon_library_entry
description: Opens a library named by a global string, follows pointers from the passed structure to a list entry and then to a second lookup, and stores the found values into the structure. It closes the opened library at the end, and the referenced text is 'WINDOW, icon.library'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:115BA
name: read_timer_device_time
description: Opens timer.device with a timer request and, if the open fails, reports the error through a library call and returns. On success it reads the current time as two result fields, releases the request and port, stores the sum through the optional pointer argument, and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:115BC
name: read_timer_device_time_direct
description: Opens timer.device and reads the current time, reporting the referenced text 'timer is not available, timer.device' through a library call when the open fails. It sums two result fields from the read, releases the request and port, stores the sum through the optional pointer, and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11672
name: perform_signed_division
description: Works out the result sign from the signs of its two operands, calls another routine to perform the division, and negates that result when the signs differ. It returns the adjusted value paired with the second operand.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:1169A
name: negate_result_if_negative
description: Calls another routine, then returns its second register result negated when the first operand is negative, paired with the original second operand. The entry sits in a gap of the static flow and has no recorded caller.

name: call_and_return_concatenated
